name: Photon Query Using Ray Tracing (BVH Acceleration)
definition: A method to accelerate photon queries for PDE estimators by formulating the query as a ray-tracing problem using hardware-accelerated BVH (e.g., OptiX/RTX), storing bounding volumes for photons and using intersection programs to evaluate estimator geometry.
summary: Photon Query Using Ray Tracing accelerates photon density estimation by using hardware-accelerated BVHs to efficiently cull non-interacting photons, outperforming brute-force linear scans in high-density scenes.
